anomalies.reason: Record 2023–2025 national peak month: Headline FAI reached 325.9 (3,177 cell-days, 105.9 cell-days/day) driven by post-harvest agricultural residue burning across the central and eastern Nile Delta (HC-all_years-001). Static-excluded FAI reached 435.5 (R = 1.336).

Early autumn SON agricultural burning surge in Kafr El-Sheikh & Dakahlia (B31N_31E): Headline FAI surged to 258.0 (2,431 cell-days across 29 usable days). Low static-proximity share (sigma_P = 17.6%) confirms genuine open-field agricultural fire activity.

2024 autumn seasonal peak in Nile Delta South & Beheira (B30N_31E / B30N_30E): Headline FAI reached 204.1 (2,056 cell-days across 31 usable days, 66.3 cell-days/day) — a 37.4% reduction from the October 2023 peak.

Secondary spring MAM peak coinciding with winter wheat & sugarcane residue clearing along the Nile corridor: Headline FAI reached 159.3 (1,605 cell-days, 51.8 cell-days/day) and static-excluded FAI reached 174.9.

2025 autumn peak in Nile Delta Core Agricultural Zone (B30N_31E): Headline FAI reached 148.0 (1,491 cell-days across 31 usable days, 48.1 cell-days/day), continuing the multi-year downward trajectory (-54.6% below October 2023).

S-NPP 19-day archive coverage gap event (2024-07-06..13 and 2024-07-19..29): reduced monthly coverage factor kappa to 0.581 (quality_label = partial_coverage, 18 usable days). Unusable days are treated as missing, never zero-filled.

riskPeriods.window: September 01 – November 15 (Autumn SON Nile Delta Residue Burning Peak)
drivers: Post-harvest rice & summer crop residue burning across B30N_31E (7,926 cell-days) and B31N_31E (4,101 cell-days)
Accounts for the primary national FAI peak every year (Oct 2023 FAI = 325.9, Oct 2024 FAI = 204.1, Oct 2025 FAI = 148.0)
Low static-source neighborhood overlap (sigma_P = 17.6–18.8%) confirms open vegetation combustion

riskPeriods.window: April 15 – May 31 (Spring MAM Wheat & Sugarcane Harvest Window)
drivers: Spring wheat, barley & sugarcane harvest residue clearing along the Nile corridor (B25N_32E Luxor/Qena to B30N_31E)
Secondary national peak in May (May 2023 FAI = 159.3, May 2024 FAI = 113.1, May 2025 FAI = 97.6)
Strong daytime detection share during 10:00–12:00 UTC (12:00–14:00 Cairo local time) overpass window

riskPeriods.window: Year-Round Persistent Type 2 Static Thermal Flare Baseline
drivers: 267 persistent 0.05° static thermal source cells generating 168,263 detections (65.6–69.3% of raw VIIRS rows)
Concentrated in West Alexandria (G622_596: 1,069 days), Matrouh basins (B30N_26E/27E), and Western Desert facilities
33.4% of Type 0 candidate cell-days fall within 3×3 cells of static sources, requiring excl3x3 sensitivity tracking

riskPeriods.window: Year-Round Suez Gulf & Red Sea Petrochemical / Industrial Corridor
drivers: Persistent industrial, cement & gas-flaring thermal anomalies in B30N_32E (1,978 cell-days) and B29N_32E (1,929 cell-days)
1,223 Type 3 offshore/coastal water detections separated from inland Type 0 vegetation candidates during Phase 3
Requires 0.05° grid deduplication and static-source neighborhood diagnostics

regionMeta.name: All Egypt (National Composite 22°N–32°N)
regionMeta.biome: Nile Delta & Valley irrigated croplands + desert/coastal industrial basins
regionMeta.description: Complete Egypt national active-fire & thermal anomaly domain (254,175 harmonized rows across MODIS, S-NPP, NOAA-20, and NOAA-21 on a 0.05° × 0.05° grid).

regionMeta.name: Nile Delta & Greater Cairo (B30N_30E–B31N_31E)
regionMeta.biome: Intensive irrigated deltaic cropland (rice, wheat, maize)
regionMeta.description: Primary national agricultural fire concentration zone led by B30N_31E (7,926 cell-days), B31N_31E (4,101 cell-days), and B30N_30E (3,190 cell-days), peaking sharply in September–October.

regionMeta.name: Middle & Upper Egypt Nile Valley (B24N–B29N)
regionMeta.biome: Alluvial Nile corridor floodplain (sugarcane & winter wheat)
regionMeta.description: Linear agricultural corridor from Beni Suef and Minya (B28N_30E) through Assiut and Qena/Luxor (B25N_32E: 1,705 cell-days) to Aswan, with pronounced spring (MAM) harvest activity.

regionMeta.name: NW Coast, Alexandria West & Western Desert (B29N–B31N)
regionMeta.biome: Coastal Mediterranean steppe, hydrocarbon basins & desert oases
regionMeta.description: Encompasses West Alexandria industrial zone (B31N_29E), Matrouh/Western Desert basins (B30N_27E: 2,380 cell-days; B29N_27E: 1,833 cell-days), and Western oases.

regionMeta.name: Suez Gulf, Sinai & Red Sea Coast (B24N_33E–B31N_32E)
regionMeta.biome: Eastern Canal zone, Suez Gulf petrochemical corridor & Sinai
